ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Retainer renewals, Awaiting signature and later stages need Amount and Close date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Retainer_renewals", CASE(StageName, "Upcoming", 1, "Review booked", 2, "Proposal sent (Retainer renewals)", 3, "Negotiation (Retainer renewals)", 4, "Awaiting signature", 5, "Renewed", 6, 0) >= 5, OR(ISBLANK(Amount), ISBLANK(CloseDate)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Amount and Close date before moving to Awaiting signature.
